name: Maneuver detection
description: Maneuver detection over any pluggable propagator. detect_maneuvers takes element sets ($OMM) and asks for each set's trajectory on a propagator query port (the host routes each query to the plugged propagator: SGP4, HPOP, an ABI provider; inertial or Earth-fixed answers) or takes per-set trajectories ($OEM), and emits $MNV DETECTED from three detectors: D1, the crossing of consecutive trajectories with a median step test; D2, a robust GLR step test on orbit-averaged energy levels and the orbit-normal chain; D3, a GLR test for a change of energy rate (low thrust). compare_ephemerides checks planned maneuvers ($MNV) against successive operator ephemeris versions ($OEM: executed, cancelled or unknown, with the executed delta-V) and reports changes between versions. score_detections matches detected $MNV to truth $MNV (recall, time error, delta-V ratio, false alarms).

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic statistics over caller-supplied element sets, trajectories and records. No host calls, threads, propagation or network access: trajectories come from the caller through the propagator query port.

inputPorts.description: Element sets ($OMM, plain or a stream of size-prefixed records): the module asks for their trajectories on propagation_requests and reads the answers on propagation. Grouped by NORAD_CAT_ID (else OBJECT_ID, else OBJECT_NAME); one set per EPOCH (a later record replaces an earlier one).

Answers to propagation_requests: one $OEM data block per query, in query order (a refused set: an empty block whose COMMENT begins REFUSED). UTC, km and km/s, Earth-centred inertial or Earth-fixed axes (Earth-fixed states are turned to TEME by GMST).

Per-set trajectories supplied by the caller, instead of element sets: one data block per element set spanning its neighbouring sets' epochs (two on each side), grouped by object and ordered by the midpoint of their span.

wildcardJustification.detail: Detection options as a JSON object (detectors, propagator_port_id, D1, D2 and D3 thresholds, neighbour_sets, grid_step_s, report_time, report_pairs, report_levels); every field optional.

inputPorts.description: Detection options as a JSON object; every field optional.

outputPorts.description: One $MNV frame per detected maneuver, STATUS DETECTED.

wildcardJustification.detail: {status: needs-propagation, propagator_port_id, neighbour_sets, queries: [{sequence, object, norad, object_id, set, epoch, start, stop, step_s}]}: one trajectory per element set for the host to route to the plugged propagator.

outputPorts.description: The trajectories the detector needs, when element sets arrive without answers.

wildcardJustification.detail: Per-object pairs, levels and each detector's events with their evidence; the scientific result is the $MNV frames.

outputPorts.description: Per-object evidence of every detector as JSON.

inputPorts.description: Ephemeris versions: one $OEM per version (CREATION_DATE is its issue time), one data block per object.
Planned maneuvers ($MNV): EVENT_START_TIME the TIG, DELTA_VEL the planned size (km/s), SAT_NO or ORIG_OBJECT_ID the object.

wildcardJustification.detail: margin_s, post_start_after_s, executed_fraction, cancelled_fraction, unplanned_threshold_km, within_version, report_time; every field optional.

inputPorts.description: Options as a JSON object; every field optional.

outputPorts.description: Each planned maneuver checked (STATUS EXECUTED, CANCELLED or UNKNOWN, with the executed delta-V), and version changes above unplanned_threshold_km (STATUS DETECTED).

wildcardJustification.detail: Per object: version changes (mode, window, delta SMA, in-track and cross-track delta-V) and each planned maneuver's pre and post versions, modelled and executed change.

inputPorts.description: Truth maneuvers ($MNV): EVENT_START_TIME to EVENT_END_TIME, delta-V from DELTA_VEL or from MNVR_ACCEL_TIMES / MNVR_ACCELS (U, V, W per point, km/s^2, held until the next time).

wildcardJustification.detail: before_s, after_s, bins_mps, explained, assessed and spans ([{object, from, to}]); every field optional.

inputPorts.description: Matching window and intervals as a JSON object.

wildcardJustification.detail: Recall with its Wilson interval, by delta-V bin, time error and delta-V ratio distributions, false alarms per object-year, and every match, miss and unmatched event.
